H3200.def: patronymically from «03199»; a Jakinite (collectively) or descendants of Jakin:--Jachinites.

H3201.def: or (fuller) yakowl {yaw-kole'}; a primitive root; to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might):--be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.

H3202.def: (Aramaic) or ykiyl (Aramaic) {yek-eel'}; to «03201»:--be able, can, couldest, prevail.

H3203.def: and Ykolyahuw {yek-ol-yaw'-hoo}; or (2 Chronicles 26:3) Ykiylyah {yek-ee-leh-yaw'}; from «03201» and «03050»; Jah will enable; Jekoljah or Jekiljah, an Israelitess:--Jecholiah, Jecoliah.

H3204.def: and Ykonyahuw {yek-on-yaw'-hoo}; or (Jereremiah 27:20) Ykownyah {yek-o-neh-yaw'}; from «03559» and «03050»; Jah will establish; Jekonjah, a Jewish king:--Jeconiah. Compare «03659».

H3205.def: a primitive root; to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage:--bear, beget, birth((-day)), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail(-eth, -ing woman).

H3206.def: from «03205»; something born, i.e. a lad or offspring:--boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).

H3212.def: a primitive root (compare «01980»); to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses):--X again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, + follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, + pursue, cause to run, spread, take away ((-journey)), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, × be weak.

H3213.def: a primitive root; to howl (with a wailing tone) or yell (with a boisterous one):--(make to) howl, be howling.

H3216.def: a primitive root; to blurt or utter inconsiderately:--devour.

H3217.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to stick or scrape
H3217.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to stick or scrape; scurf or tetter:--scabbed.

H3218.et: from an unused root meaning to lick up
H3218.def: from an unused root meaning to lick up; a devourer; specifically, the young locust:--cankerworm, caterpillar.

H3219.def: from «03950»; a travelling pouch (as if for gleanings):-scrip.

H3220.et: from an unused root meaning to roar
H3220.def: from an unused root meaning to roar; a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south:--sea (X -faring man, (-shore)), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).

H3222.def: from the same as «03117»; a warm spring:--mule.

H3223.pos:
Jemuel = "day of God"
  1. the eldest son of Simeon
H3223.def: from «03117» and «0410»; day of God; Jemuel, an Israelite:--Jemuel.

H3224.def: perhaps from the same as «03117»; properly, warm, i.e. affectionate; hence, dove (compare «03123»); Jemimah, one of Job's daughters:--Jemimah.

H3225.def: from «03231»; the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south:--+ left-handed, right (hand, side), south.

H3226.def: the same as «03225»; Jamin, the name of three Israelites:--Jamin. See also «01144».

H3228.def: patronymically from «03226»; a Jeminite (collectively) or descendants of Jamin:--Jaminites. See also «0ll45».

H3229.def: or Yimlah {yim-law'}; from «04390»; full; Jimla or Jimlah, an Israelite:--Imla, Imlah.

H3230.def: from «04427»; he will make king; Jamlek, an Israelite:--Jamlech.

H3231.def: a primitive root; to be (physically) right (i.e. firm); but used only as denominative from «03225» and transitive, to be right-handed or take the right-hand side:--go (turn) to (on, use) the right hand.

H3232.def: from «03231»; prosperity (as betokened by the right hand); Jimnah, the name of two Israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them:--Imna, Imnah, Jimnah, Jimnites.

H3233.def: from «03231»; right (i.e. at the right hand): -(on the) right (hand).

H3234.def: from «04513»; he will restrain; Jimna, an Israelite: -Imna.

H3235.def: a primitive root; to exchange; by implication, to change places:--boast selves, change.

H3236.def: probably from «03235»; interchange; Jimrah, an Israelite:-- Imrah.

H3238.def: a primitive root; to rage or be violent: by implication, to suppress, to maltreat:--destroy, (thrust out by) oppress(-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence.

H3239.def: from «03240»; quiet; Janoach or Janochah, a place in Palestine:--Janoah, Janohah.

H3240.def: a primitive root; to deposit; by implication, to allow to stay:--bestow, cast down, lay (down, up), leave (off), let alone (remain), pacify, place, put, set (down), suffer, withdraw, withhold. (The Hiphil forms with the dagesh are here referred to, in accordance with the older grammarians; but if any distinction of the kind is to be made, these should rather be referred to «05117», and the others here.)

H3241.def: from «05123»; asleep; Janim, a place in Palestine: -Janum (from the margin).

H3242.def: from «03243»; a sucker or sapling:--young twig.

H3243.def: a primitive root; to suck; causatively, to give milk:--milch, nurse(-ing mother), (give, make to) suck(-ing child, -ling).

H3244.def: or yanshowph {yan-shofe'}; apparently from «05398»; an unclean (acquatic) bird; probably the heron (perhaps from its blowing cry, or because the night-heron is meant (compare «05399»))):--(great) owl.s

H3245.def: a primitive root; to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e. settle, consult:--appoint, take counsel, establish, (lay the, lay for a) found(-ation), instruct, lay, ordain, set, × sure.

H3246.def: from «03245»; a foundation (figuratively, i.e. beginning):--X began.

H3247.def: from «03245»; a foundation (literally or figuratively):--bottom, foundation, repairing

H3251.def: a primitive root; to pour (intransitive):--be poured.

H3252.et: from an unused root meaning to watch
H3252.def: from an unused root meaning to watch; observant; Jiskah, sister of Lot:--Iscah.

H3253.def: from «05564» and «03050»; Jah will sustain; Jismakjah, an Israelite:--Ismachiah.

H3254.def: a primitive root; to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing):--add, × again, × any more, × cease, × come more, + conceive again, continue, exceed, × further, × gather together, get more, give more-over, × henceforth, increase (more and more), join, × longer (bring, do, make, much, put), × (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be (strong-) er, × yet, yield.

H3256.def: a primitive root; to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct:--bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach.

H3258.et: from an unused root probably meaning to grieve
H3258.def: from an unused root probably meaning to grieve; sorrowful; Jabets, the name of an Israelite, and also of a place in Palestine: -Jabez.

H3259.def: a primitive root; to fix upon (by agreement or appointment); by implication, to meet (at a stated time), to summon (to trial), to direct (in a certain quarter or position), to engage (for marriage): -agree,(maxke an) appoint(-ment,a time), assemble (selves), betroth, gather (selves, together), meet (together), set (a time).

H3260.def: from «03259»; appointed; Jedi, an Israelite:--Iddo (from the margin) See «03035».

H3261.def: a primitive root; apparently to brush aside:--sweep away.

H3262.def: from «03261» and «0410»; carried away of God; Jeuel, the name of four Israelites; -Jehiel, Jeiel, Jeuel. Compare «03273».

H3265.et: apparently the passive participle of the same as (03293)
H3265.def: apparently the passive participle of the same as «03293»; wooded; Jaur, an Israelite:--Jair(from the margin).

H3266.def: from «05789»; hasty; Jeush, the name of an Edomite and of four Israelites:--Jehush, Jeush. Compare «03274».

H3267.def: a primitive root; to be bold or obstinate: d-fierce.

H3268.def: from «03267» and «0410»; emboldened of God; Jaaziel, an Israelite:--Jaaziel.

H3269.def: from «03267» and «03050»; emboldened of Jah; Jaazijah, an Israelite:--Jaaziah.

H3270.def: or Yazer {yah-zare'}; from «05826»; helpful; Jaazer or Jazer, a place East of the Jordan:--Jaazer, Jazer.

H3272.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03289»; to counsel; reflexively, to consult:--counsellor, consult together.

H3273.def: from «03261» and «0410»; carried away of God; Jeiel, the name of six Israelites:--Jeiel, Jehiel. Compare «03262».

H3274.def: from «05789»; hasty; Jeish, the name of an Edomite and of a an Israelite:--Jeush (from the margin). Compare «03266».

H3275.def: from the same as «05912»; troublesome; Jakan, an Israelite:--Jachan.

H3276.def: a primitive root; properly, to ascend; figuratively, to be valuable (objectively: useful, subjectively: benefited):--X at all, set forward, can do good, (be, have) profit, (able).

H3278.def: the same as «03277»; Jael, a Canaanite:--Jael.

H3279.et: the same as (03280) or direct from (03276)
H3279.def: or Yaaalah {yah-al-aw'}; the same as «03280» or direct from «03276»; Jaala or Jaalah, one of the Nethinim:--Jaala, Jaalah.

H3282.et: from an unused root meaning to pay attention
H3282.def: from an unused root meaning to pay attention; properly, heed; by implication, purpose (sake or account); used adverbially to indicate the reason or cause:--because (that), forasmuch (+ as), seeing then, + that, + wheras, + why.

H3283.def: from the same as «03282»; the ostrich (probably from its answering cry:--ostrich.

H3284.def: feminine of «03283», and meaning the same:--+ owl.

H3285.def: from the same as «03283»; responsive; Jaanai, an Israelite:--Jaanai.

H3286.def: a primitive root; to tire (as if from wearisome flight):--faint, cause to fly, (be) weary (self).

H3289.def: a primitive root; to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve:--advertise, take advise, advise (well), consult, (give, take) counsel(-lor), determine, devise, guide, purpose.

H3290.def: from «06117»; heel-catcher (i.e. supplanter); Jaakob, the Israelitish patriarch:--Jacob.

H3292.def: from the same as «06130»; Jaakan, an Idumaean: -Jaakan. Compare «01142».

H3293.et: from an unused root probably meaning to thicken with verdure
H3293.def: from an unused root probably meaning to thicken with verdure; a copse of bushes; hence, a forest; hence, honey in the comb (as hived in trees):--(honey-)comb, forest, wood.

H3294.def: a form of «03295»; Jarah, an Israelite:--Jarah.

H3295.def: feminine of «03293», and meaning the same:--(honey-) comb, forest.

H3296.et: from the pl. of (03293) and the masc. pl. act. participle of (707)
H3296.def: from the plural of «03293» and the masculine plural active participle of «0707»; woods of weavers; Jaare-Oregim, an Israelite:--Jaare-oregim.

H3297.def: plural of «03293»; forests; Jearim, a place in Palestine:--Jearim. Compare «07157».

H3298.et: from an unused root of uncertain signification and (03050)
H3298.def: from an unused root of uncertain signification and «03050»; Jaareshjah, an Israelite:--Jaresiah.

H3299.def: from «06213»; they will do; Jaasu, an Israelite: -Jaasau.
